description: A REPLACE statement anywhere a character-string may appear, with no separator period before it (§2002:7.1.3.2 SR1 "A REPLACE statement may be specified anywhere in source text or in library text that a character-string or a separator, other than the closing delimiter of a literal, may appear"). ANSI X3.23-1985 required the opposite (§1985:XII.3.3 SR1: "It must be preceded by a separator period except when it is the first statement in a separately compiled program"); ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 113 lists the relaxation as a 2002 addition ("Previously, a REPLACE statement was required to follow a separator period when it was other than the first statement in an outermost program"). The introduction gate is CopyProcessor.ApplyReplaceStatements (kb/Work PB5085), asked of a REPLACE whose preceding text-word is no separator period.
display: a REPLACE statement not preceded by a separator period
